prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create production artwork for Futbol Island interactive stories. Attached image is the visual style and character identity reference, NOT an edit target. Match its polished faceted low-poly 3D cinematography, believable lighting, textured grass, island waterfront, charcoal futbol kits, expressive faces and carefully modelled hair. No primitive flat vector art. IMPORTANT FORMAT: ONE tall portrait storyboard atlas, exactly THREE equal-height landscape panels stacked vertically, edge-to-edge, no gutters or borders, identical camera framing across panels, each panel 3:2, overall image 1:2. Aim 1536x3072. Each panel must be a complete scene, with all main faces and bodies comfortably inside it. No typography, labels, captions, logos, interface elements, arrows or speech bubbles; jersey numbers are allowed. Maintain character identity and outfits across panels. The three panels are alternative emotional moments, not simultaneous action. Cast: Luna, the central brown-haired high ponytail girl number10 in reference, and Kai, curly dark-haired boy in reference. Warm afternoon near island goal. TOP: Luna has just missed a chance, shoulders lowered, ball wide of goal; Kai nearby giving space. MIDDLE: Luna takes a breath and looks back toward play, upright ready to offer support, ball stays wide. BOTTOM: Kai stands beside Luna giving a gentle encouraging cue; Luna listens and looks toward play. Emotion subtle, supportive and credible. Luna must retain reference ponytail, brown eyes and charcoal kit.
